selection: Contrasting existing artistic and mechanical/design development biographies, chosen before external results.
method: Page-by-page response assignments for BOTH profiles frozen before seeing either result. No real student data, no account, payment, or new agreement. Provider item IDs and concise construct paraphrases retained; full proprietary questionnaire not republished.
responsePolicy: 1-5 ascending interest or agreement, as actually labeled on each page. Neutral3 explicitly codes synthetic uncertainty where biographies do not resolve a preference; it is NOT an actual student neutral response. Prefer4 for a supported adjacent interest,5 only for clear repeated preference. Unknown personality traits remain3; do not convert biography into measured aptitude. Separate nonidentical-item convergence from exact-score agreement. Provider occupations are not ground truth. No engine weights or career assignments tuned to these outputs.
limits: Two convenience synthetic cases; response inference and neutral imputation are major limitations. This is a different questionnaire/implementation, still shares Holland theory. Cannot establish psychometric independence or predictive validity.
